reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 7 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Bulls.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Knicks win 66 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.
